flagged.title: Characters: Sheila, Eric, Gerald and Mrs Birling
flagged.reason: The video teaches a fabricated direct quote for Eric ('he's been here and we all know what we did') and incorrectly claims Mrs Birling is the only character who never accepts responsibility (ignoring Mr Birling).

mark_affecting.quote: He says, 'he's been here and we all know what we did.'
Mrs Birling is the only character who never accepts any responsibility.
